strategy.summary: CART-12 prices the cart at checkout in src/cart.js: bulk discount (10% off at 10+ items summed over quantities), the SAVE5 coupon applied after it with a $0 floor on goods, unknown coupons refused, and shipping ($4.99, free from $50 after discounts, nothing for an empty cart). Unit tests against bulkDiscount/cartTotal must prove each rule and its boundaries. Reading the code shows `itemCount > BULK_THRESHOLD`, so a cart of exactly 10 items gets no discount — a suspected defect against AC1.
outOfScope: Any UI or API for checkout (none exists in the repo)
assumptions: Coupon codes are case-sensitive as the code implements (only exact 'SAVE5' is known)
A non-empty cart whose goods are floored at $0 still pays $4.99 shipping, as AC3 reads (goods < $50)
Thresholds are imported from src/cart.js where useful; expected amounts are literal dollars computed by hand
openQuestions: Should a cart that becomes $0 with a coupon still pay shipping?

risks.description: Off-by-one at the 10-item threshold (code uses > instead of >=)
risks.mitigation: TC1 asserts exactly 10 items spread over lines get 10% off; kept as expected-fail with a defect if it fails

risks.description: Coupon applied before the bulk discount gives a different total
risks.mitigation: TC3 uses amounts where the order changes the total

risks.description: Shipping threshold checked on the subtotal instead of discounted goods
risks.mitigation: TC6 and TC9 put the subtotal above $50 and discounted goods at/below it

acceptanceCriteria.text: A cart with 10 or more items in total (sum of line quantities) gets 10% off its subtotal; fewer gets none.
SAVE5 takes $5 off after the bulk discount, goods never below $0; any other coupon code is refused with an error.
Shipping is free when goods after discounts are $50 or more, otherwise $4.99; an empty cart costs $0.

strategy.environmentNotes: Pure unit tests; no services or env vars. Run with npm test (vitest run).

defects.title: Bulk discount not applied at exactly 10 items
defects.description: AC1 says 10 or more items get 10% off. bulkDiscount in src/cart.js compares itemCount > BULK_THRESHOLD, so a 10-item cart gets no discount.
